revisions.note: Added the data (.eeg) and marker (.vmrk) file each header names (DataFile, MarkerFile) (720 files, 4352454383 bytes); the original sourcedata snapshot held only the 360 BrainVision headers (subjectXX/matrixSpeller_Block*_Run*.vhdr). Source: Zenodo record 5831879 (10.5281/zenodo.5831879), members of the per-subject archives subjectXX.zip. Each archive was downloaded from Zenodo and checked against the size and MD5 the Zenodo API publishes; members were extracted with their CRC-32 checked. Every header already in the deposit is byte-identical (SHA-256) to its member in the same archive.
